name: Oda Kiyoko
source:
[i]"I'm waiting for your request, my cute [b]son[/b]."[/i]

The wife of "Oda Osamuyu" Onsen, a public bath that has been loved in the city for many years.
Although she works as a staff member, her husband and her husband's parents do most of the work.
She works under contract with "Bunny's Mam" to help with childcare and to make a little money for the family.
[url=https://vndb.org/c122748]Ayato[/url] and Kiyoko have a relationship like brother and sister, as they have always met on their way to school. Her two daughters also adore Ayato. Their relationship is good.
However, Kiyoko has always had a strong desire to raise her own son. But she was gifted with 2 daughters instead. 
She always wanted to spoil Ayato, who had no mother, as his mother.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1213893&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
